title: 第13章 拷问韩宅第14章 分赃三张紫卡
content_zh:
“那……路爷您开个价？”韩老五讨好道。
“至少三千两。”路沉狮子大开口。
韩老五脸色骤变，眼底那点谄媚瞬间被凶光盖过“路沉，你莫要欺人太甚！冯师爷是我女婿，我要是有个三长两短，你们谁也别想活！”
瞎子阴森一笑，手中攮子忽地闪过一抹冷光，锋利的刀尖已贴上韩老五的面颊。
只见他手腕微微一旋。
一片皮肉便像削果子皮似的被剔了下来。
韩老五疼得五官都拧成了一堆，额上青筋暴起，却死死憋住了那口气，硬是没叫出声来。
拴虎的刀，此刻正死死压在他颈侧的命脉上。
只要他敢发出丁点儿声音。
拴虎一刀就能要了他的命。
“你这些年放印子钱，收阎王债，三千两拿不出，三百两的家底总有的吧。你有多少家当，自己清楚。”路沉淡淡道。
“呵”
韩老五喉间挤出一声怪笑。
他在街面上混了十几年，打过架、杀过人、蹲过大牢、受过刑、偷过东西、贩过人口。黑道里能沾的，他早沾遍了。
南城这片地界上，提他韩老五的字号，混混堆里谁不得掂量掂量。
此刻韩老五再明白不过。
钱一给，自己必死无疑。路沉定会灭口。
韩老五既知无活路。
既然横竖是死，那点惧意倒被一股子戾气顶了下去。
“路沉！我日你娘！要钱？下辈子吧！老子烂命一条，你有种就一刀捅死我！冯师爷不把你抽筋扒皮，我跟你姓！”他嘶声叫骂，面目扭曲如癫。

路沉冷笑“杀你？不急。我会慢慢折磨你，直到你肯说为止。”
“呸！来啊！小畜生，有什么阴招损招，尽管往你爷爷身上使！我要是吭一声，就是你养的！”韩老五目眦欲裂，梗着脖子狂吼道。
拴虎见他已失控，不再多话，攥紧拳头朝他太阳穴猛力一捶！
韩老五脑袋一歪，彻底昏死过去。
几人用麻绳将他捆作一团，嘴里塞了块麻核桃，罩上麻袋，趁天黑摸出城外，直上北山。
山路崎岖，约莫半个时辰后，路沉等人钻进一处山坳里的破庙。
二狗几个早已笼好了火，候着。
路沉几人将麻袋撂在干草堆上，对二狗道
“吊上梁。这老油子骨头硬，急不得，得慢慢磨。”
破庙中篝火燃了整整一宿。韩老五被悬在梁下，浑身上下没一块好肉，血顺着裤腿往下淌，在积灰的地面上洇开一团深色。
他始终咬着牙，半个字也不吐。
天蒙蒙亮时。
路沉留下瞎子继续拷问，自己带人悄然回城，倒头睡到晌午。
下午，他又如往常一样去了武馆练拳，仿佛昨夜什么都没发生。
至于北城黄米胡同死的那几个泼皮，压根无人问津。
北城帮派林立，比南城更凶更乱。
街头巷尾，帮会仇杀是常事，哪天真不死人，反倒稀奇了。
县衙的人早就看惯了这等无头命案，没苦主追着告，没油水可捞，自然也懒得伸手。卷宗一合，便算是江湖恩怨，自行了断了。
瞎子在山上熬了他两天两夜。
这老混混的骨头比他料想的还硬，比牲口还扛造。

鞭打、火燎、竹签穿指，一桩桩试过去，他硬是没吭一声。

content_en:
"Then... Mr. Lu, would you like to give me a price?" Han Laowu asked in a flattering tone.
"At least three thousand taels." Lu Shenzi said loudly.
Han Laowu's expression suddenly changed, and the flattery in his eyes was instantly overshadowed by the fierce light. "Lu Chen, don't bully others too much! Master Feng is my son-in-law. If something happens to me, none of you will survive!"
The blind man smiled sinisterly, a cold light suddenly flashed across the knife in his hand, and the sharp tip of the knife was pressed against Han Laowu's cheek.
I saw his wrist twist slightly.
A piece of skin and flesh was peeled off like peeling a fruit.
Han Laowu's facial features were twisted into a pile of pain, and veins popped up on his forehead, but he held his breath tightly and did not scream out.
The knife that tied the tiger was pressing firmly on the lifeline on the side of his neck.
As long as he dares to make a little sound.
Shuanhu can kill him with one knife.
"You have made loan sharks and collected debts from the King of Hell over the years. You can't get out three thousand taels. You must have a family worth three hundred taels. You know how much property you have." Lu Chen said calmly.
"Heh"
Han Laowu squeezed out a strange laugh from his throat.
He has been on the streets for more than ten years, fighting, killing, jailing, being tortured, stealing, and human trafficking. He had already touched everything he could in the underworld.
In the land of Nancheng, no one among the gangsters could weigh in on the name of Han Laowu.
At this moment, Han Laowu couldn't understand it more clearly.
As soon as the money is given, he will definitely die. Lu Shen will definitely be silenced.
Han Laowu knew there was no way out.
Since it was death anyway, that little bit of fear was suppressed by a wave of hostility.
"Lu Chen! I'm your mother! Want money? In the next life! I'm going to die. If you have the guts, stab me to death! If Master Feng doesn't peel you off, I'll take your surname!" He screamed and cursed, his face twisted like a madman.
Lu Chen sneered, "Kill you? No hurry. I will torture you slowly until you are willing to say it."
"Bah! Come on! Little beast, if you have any dirty tricks, just use them on your grandpa! If I say a word, you raised me!" Han Laowu's eyes were about to burst, and he held his neck and roared.
Seeing that he had lost control, Shuanhu stopped talking and clenched his fists and punched him hard on the temple!
Han Laowu tilted his head and fainted completely.
Several people tied him into a ball with hemp rope, stuffed a piece of sesame walnut in his mouth, covered him with a sack, and went out of the city while it was dark, heading straight up Beishan.
The mountain road was rugged. About half an hour later, Lu Chen and others got into a ruined temple in a mountain col.
The two dogs had already set up the fire and were waiting.
Lu Chen and others put the sacks on the haystack and said to the two dogs:
"Hang it on the beam. This old fat man's bones are very hard. You can't rush. You have to grind them slowly."
The bonfire burned in the ruined temple all night long. Han Laowu was hung under the beam, with not a single piece of flesh on his body. Blood was dripping down his trouser legs, spreading into a dark mass on the dusty ground.
He kept gritting his teeth and never uttered a single word.
When the sky is dark.
Lu Chen left the blind man behind to continue the torture, and quietly led his men back to the city, where he fell asleep until noon.
In the afternoon, he went to the martial arts gym to practice boxing as usual, as if nothing happened last night.
As for the gangsters who died in Huangmi Hutong in Beicheng, no one cared about them at all.
There are many gangs in North City, which are more violent and chaotic than in South City.
On the streets, gang vendettas are commonplace, but it is rare to see someone die.
The people in the county government have long been accustomed to seeing such headless murder cases. They have no perpetrators to pursue and accuse them, and there is no money to be made, so naturally they are too lazy to reach out. Once the files are combined, all the grievances in the world will be settled on their own.
The blind man stayed up on the mountain for two days and two nights.
This old gangster's bones were harder than he expected, stronger than an animal's.
Whipping, burning, and bamboo sticks piercing his fingers, he tried one after another, but he just didn't make a sound.
